subject.why: The subject clearly depicts an open burlap pouch with three glowing green beans spilling out and a soft golden glow.

category.why: The pouch rests on a plain flat pink surface with a darker magenta vertical gradient wall behind it, meeting the Category 2 requirements.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The object is centrally placed with generous margins on all sides and nothing is cropped.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and vibrant, with strong separation between the object and background.

detail.why: The pouch is covered in a dense, realistic burlap weave micro-texture, violating the rule against busy surface patterns and micro-detail.

style.why: The realistic fabric texture looks photographic/bump-mapped rather than having the simplified, smooth chunky volumes and satin sheen shown in the references.

fix: Remove the realistic burlap weave micro-texture and give the pouch smooth, stylized chunky surfaces with a soft satin sheen like the references.
